title: Same Ads, Every Market
description: Corporate sends one-size-fits-all creative. Your franchisees in Phoenix and Portland get the same ad. That's why CPL keeps climbing.

title: No Cross-Location Visibility
description: You can't see which locations are winning, which creative is converting, or where the budget is leaking. Decisions get made on gut feeling instead of data.

title: Speed-to-Lead Is Killing Conversion
description: Most franchise leads sit in a CRM for hours, sometimes days, before anyone reaches out. By the time you call, they've already booked with a competitor. You pay for the lead and lose the sale.
